title: Reckon Quest
description: A simple and straightforward quest plugin that makes your server way more fun.
body:
# ⚔️ Reckon Quest
![reckonquest logo](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ea8408d5fb1960cc798f6602a5aae50ca5fcb3cd.png)
**Reckon Quest** adds a powerful yet lightweight quest system to your Minecraft server.  
Create custom missions, reward players, and make exploration more exciting than ever!

![reckonquest](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/3c1af4c7f75561f04f5d9706d10226e2d6a25759.png)

## 🎯 Supported Quest Types
- **CRAFT_ITEM** – Craft items in a workbench  
- **SMELT_ITEM** – Smelt items in a furnace  
- **CONSUME_ITEM** – Eat or drink items  
- **ENCHANT_ITEM** – Enchant items at an enchanting table  
- **COLLECT_ITEM** – Pick up items from the ground  
- **USE_ANVIL** – Use an anvil to repair or rename  
- **KILL_MOB** – Kill specific mobs  
- **INTERACT_ENTITY** – Interact with any entity (right-click)  
- **BREED_ANIMAL** – Breed animals using food  
- **DAMAGE_ENTITY** – Deal damage to entities  
- **TAME_ANIMAL** – Tame animals with items  
- **KILL_ENTITY_TYPE** – Kill entities of a specific type  
- **TRADE_VILLAGER** – Trade with villagers  
- **FISH_ITEM** – Catch fish while fishing  
- **REACH_LOCATION** – Travel to specific coordinates  
More Objective Coming Soon

## Commands
- /reckonquests- for gui
- /quest reload- reload all configs
  

## 🌟 Features
- Lightweight & easy to configure  
- Custom rewards and objectives  
- Perfect for survival and RPG-style servers
- Supports icon changes
- Create Multiple Quest
- Create Quest with another Quest dependencies
- Easy to Make

## Quest Web Editor 
- In progress which allow to create quest in short and easy way as possible
